text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...I've gotta win, after all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Teio isn't here, and above all, it's a 
distance that suits me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
All the conditions are met. If we lose 
with this, it really won't be funny... 
right?
choice_data_list: Relax your shoulders a bit more.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Aha, what're you talking about? It's not 
like I was even trying that hard, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still, I figured I ought to check on the 
practical stuff first, you know?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Because if I can't show results here, 
then coming all the way to Kokura was 
totally pointless."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...All right! Results, results, gotta get 
results~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'm heading out.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(...The Trainer is the only one who knows 
the real you today.)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(Don't get scared, Nature. Hang in there, 
you can do it—)
Do your best, big sis!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Eep!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh, wha, what...?

text_block_list.name: Kokura Fishmonger
text_block_list.text:
The Kokura Kinen is our race! I'd be so 
thrilled if you won it, big sis!

text_block_list.name: Everyone from Kokura
text_block_list.text: That's right, that's right! Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"People from the Kokura shopping 
arcade...? They... came all this way for 
me...?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait a sec! Everyone, what happened to 
the store!?

text_block_list.name: Kokura Fishmonger
text_block_list.text:
"It'll be fine! Everyone's gonna be 
gathered here today anyway!"

text_block_list.name: Kokura Lady
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! You're feeling anxious 
'cause you don't know the place, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Kokura Lady
text_block_list.text: We're rootin' for ya! Give it your best!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... What's with that? Jeez... you're 
all way too sweet.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But it's not an unfamiliar place anymore! 
Thanks to everyone coming here!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: (...Yeah, I'm okay. I can run properly.)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone is watching me. ――Keep your head 
up, one step at a time!)
